summary: Service page under the Bridging menu. Silver Oak Capital (London broker) presents post-planning land acquisition finance as a short-term bridging loan secured against land that already carries some form of planning consent (full permission, outline permission or permitted development rights). It is paid as a single lump sum used purely to complete the site purchase, which the page contrasts with staged/tranched development finance. Stated timeline: purchase completed in about 2-4 weeks, with a loan term of roughly 6-12 months to arrange build finance and discharge planning conditions before refinancing onto a development loan. A related FAQ entry (apparently on /faq/) gives a typical term of 12-18 months as a 'safety buffer' (contradiction with 6-12 months), says developer experience is less critical for a pure land bridge than for development finance but the lender will still want the exit strategy, and says the firm has access to niche pre-planning bridge lenders for unconsented land where location and planning logic are sound. Snippets only; full page text, meta description, H1, rates, LTV, fees and CTAs for this page were not revealed.
